evidence: Geometry and hydrology on committed products: geography's drainage of the climate run A28_dim5_moon over LOLA at 16 pixels a degree above the GRAIL geoid (a first estimate; the lakes are regenerated once the design case settles), labelled as lake_oxygen labels it; groundwater stage 2's mature central water table re-solved from its own saved heads, reproducing its product; the sea chemistry's box model scaled to each closed lake's turnover; the springs' modelled water. No lake model runs here, and no lunar lake has been measured.
reading_rule: Areas in km2 of lake surface, volumes in km3, depths in m below each lake's level. by_deepest bins the bodies by their deepest point, (lo, hi]; floor_within_km2 and volume_below_km3 are keyed by a floor depth, the area of bed within it and the water below it; floor_by_local_depth_km2 follows lake_anoxia's classes (floor_depth_edges_m). cumulative gives [bodies, area] with the deepest point at or within each depth, by band. closed.by_deepest bins the closed parts by their own deepest point, with years as area-weighted medians over the parts, keyed by weathering corner (high, central, low), and by the freshening share and margin for the chemocline. groundwater gains are m a year over each body's area; renewal_below gives, for each floor depth, the share of the water below it that the inflow across the floor below it brings in a year, and the years to make it denser by each margin (kg/m3).
